item.title: FishTrippers Village Liber Tango
item.excerpt:
Made in Japan by hand in high density polyurethane.


It is an excellent lure for kingfish, tuna and pelagic fish.
Its swimming action during recovery is ultimate with extreme movements in the water!
An important sintillation on its flat sides stimulates the instinct of the big predators.

  • Lenght 200 mm

  • Gr. 83

prevItem.title: FishTripper Village Le Grand Tango
prevItem.excerpt:
“Fish that were previously inaccessible are now attainable.”

Le Grand Tango has acquired the admiration of countless anglers due to its persistent success. It is a top-notch diving pencil bait specifically crafted to entice fish that can't easily be found.

Fast response time thanks to leading-edge materials. Ensured stability and lift due to superior buoyancy. Wide flat side delivers unmatched dirt stirring and remarkable brightness.

  • Lenght 190 mm

  • Gr. 85

nextItem.title: FishTrippers Village Espuma 220
nextItem.excerpt:
The Fish Trippers Village Espuma 220 is a special popper. Designed as a Pencil Popper it draws a long bubble trail during long strokes. With short twitches the lure breaks out in zig-zag. The Espuma 220 is a great lure when fishing on overfished reefs because of its unique running behaviour.

  • Lenght 220 mm

  • Gr. 120

All Fish Trippers lures are 100% handmade from polyurethane and very resistant!

Recommended hook: BKK Lone Diablo 9/0
